biggest_catch: REJECTED: MyPoints is a real, long-running rewards program (Prodege, LLC, est. 1996), but the company publishes NO concrete payout terms publicly — points-to-cash conversion varies by reward and is only visible inside a logged-in account; third-party reports conflict (140-165 points per $1; $5-$25 minimums depending on reward). Without company-published payout figures, c2 fails.
catches: No official public page states a points-to-dollar conversion or a minimum redemption amount; the rewards catalog requires login.
Third-party figures conflict: 700 points = $5 gift cards (some sources), 1,590 points = $10 PayPal, 3,970 points = $25 PayPal (others) — none from MyPoints itself.
The only official-adjacent point valuation found is a MyPoints-sponsored sweepstakes rules PDF stating 1,700 points ≈ $10 — a promo document, not general payout terms.
PayPal redemptions reportedly require name/email match with a verified PayPal account — documented only by third parties.

c1.evidence: MyPoints is operated by Prodege, LLC (same parent as Swagbucks), established 1996 — one of the longest-running rewards programs; the site is live with active earning and redemption.

c2.evidence: FAILED: no concrete payout terms published by MyPoints itself. Conversion rates vary by reward and are shown only in the logged-in account; no public official page gives a conversion rate or minimum redemption.

c3.evidence: Free to join and use; no participation fee found.

c4.evidence: No official page containing payout terms was obtainable — only third-party reviews and a sponsored sweepstakes PDF with promo-only valuation.

eligibility: Free account; reported 13+ in the US (third-party). Earning via surveys, shopping, videos, games, emails.
notes: Reject is strictly on c2, not c1 — the company is real and long-standing. If MyPoints publishes a public rewards-terms page with concrete conversion rates and minimums, this route can be re-verified. Contrast with Swagbucks (R0198, same parent), which does publish 100 SB = $1 and 1500/500 SB thresholds officially.

s1.note: Free registration; no official eligibility restrictions published publicly.

s2.note: No fees; but no official point values, so costs cannot be assessed.

s3.note: No official processing-time commitment published (third parties report 3-10 business days).

s4.note: N/A — no official payout figures to evaluate.

s5.note: https://www.mypoints.com/ — official domain, but no payout terms published on public pages.

s6.note: Cannot build concrete steps without official payout figures.

s7.note: Official site checked 2026-09-23; no payout terms on public pages.

timing: Not published officially; third parties report 3-10 business days for rewards.
